question: Which traffic allowance does VM6 enforce on its GBP 1.75 plan: the marketing page's 2 TB or the order form's 3TB @ 1Gbps?
why: Both are first-party pages read in this run (order form 2026-11-07 says 'Monthly Traffic: 3TB @ 1Gbps'; marketing page said 'Traffic 2 TB' on 2026-10-22 and still prices the same plan). Which figure is enforced, and whether overage throttles or suspends, is unverified.
